titleZh: 長詞 orphan｜伸縮行李轉盤
hook: orphan 長詞團在行李轉盤：quintessential／circumstantial／conscientious／consequential——行李條寫不下，改貼漫畫。
script: quintessential 典型精髓。circumstantial 間接情況的。conscientious 盡責。consequential 重要／自大。consternation 驚愕。口令：轉盤寫「別被長度嚇到」，義核寫「先抓詞根口氣」。

members.senseAnchor: fully detailed and specific about particulars
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 旁證袋: circumstantial walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「旁證袋」出場：circumstantial 一上場梗就黏住——間接情況的。

members.senseAnchor: characterized by extreme care and great effort; guided by or in accordance with conscience or sense of right and wrong
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 勾選單: conscientious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「勾選單」出場：conscientious 一上場梗就黏住——盡責的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 重量牌: consequential walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「重量牌」出場：consequential 一上場梗就黏住——重要的。

members.senseAnchor: fear resulting from the awareness of danger
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 呆住臉: consternation walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「呆住臉」出場：consternation 一上場梗就黏住——驚愕。

members.senseAnchor: a bold challenge; discord resulting from a clash of ideas or opinions
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 對峙線: confrontation walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「對峙線」出場：confrontation 一上場梗就黏住——對峙。

members.senseAnchor: a symptom of reduced quality or strength; process of changing to an inferior state
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 下滑梯: deterioration walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「下滑梯」出場：deterioration 一上場梗就黏住——惡化。

members.senseAnchor: the state of being susceptible; easily affected
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 易感標: susceptibility walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「易感標」出場：susceptibility 一上場梗就黏住——易感性。

members.senseAnchor: responsibility to someone or for some activity
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 責任牌: accountability walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「責任牌」出場：accountability 一上場梗就黏住——課責。

members.senseAnchor: the act of presupposing; a supposition made prior to having knowledge (as for the purpose of argument)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 前提貼: presupposition walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「前提貼」出場：presupposition 一上場梗就黏住——預設。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 轉盤: carousel walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「轉盤」出場：carousel 一上場梗就黏住——轉盤。
